snippet.title: Dragon's Lair (NES) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of CSG (Sony) Imagesoft's 1990 platformer game for the NES, Dragon's Lair. 


_
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
